scope: read-only source-quality/alignment investigation for the staged mutant-breath OGG candidate

archive_member_identity.identity_note: The two distinct archive members are alternate encodings of one source recording in the same CC0 source archive; they are not independent takes.

decoded_alignment.cross_correlation_channel: mono average of the two decoded channels
decoded_alignment.interpretation: The alternate encodings are aligned at sample frame zero over equal 275,796-frame durations; their sample shapes are highly correlated but not sample-identical because the OGG is lossy.

wav_flat_top_scan.method: Mirrors the repository direct scanner: count decoded PCM16 values with abs(sample/32768)>=0.999; count a plateau run while successive values on a channel are identical; a probable flat-top requires a run of at least 3 and at least 6 near-rail samples total.

unclipped_tail_interval_by_this_full_sca.role_limit: This is a source-labeled breathing remainder with no full-scale rail samples, but envelope inspection does not establish a complete independent breath-cycle boundary or perceptual loop suitability. No crop was produced.

ogg_source_scan.note: The decoded lossy OGG does not preserve exact PCM rail plateaus, but it is aligned and strongly correlated with the clipped WAV alternate. Lossy smoothing is not evidence that clipped source information was repaired.

same_source_role_receipt.existing_receipt_listening_status: needs_user_review: agent audio playback content unsupported; objective file analysis only
same_source_role_receipt.note: The existing idle_breath derivation uses the full six-second source and -12 dB gain. Its zero post-gain clip count is not proof that the clipped source WAV was reconstructed.

candidate_mapping.head_tail_relationship: The final 200 ms equal-power mix combines the source tail with the source head; early clipped source events therefore reappear in this loop-boundary mix.

staged_candidate_timeline.technical_candidate_status: passes technical master gates, but source-quality risk remains because the same aligned source recording has verified full-scale plateau intervals.
staged_candidate_timeline.candidate_near_rail_scan_does_not_clear_: The final PCM16 candidate has no near-rail runs after highpass, normalization and tail/head crossfade; this measures the derivative output and does not establish repair of the clipped recording.

conclusion.promotion_status: remain held pending parent source selection/listening; do not call OGG flat-top smoothing a clip repair
